title: Fatima kubra duqtare shabbir
body:
Fatima kubra duqtar e shabbir
Qush huwi thi ke ho gayi dilgeer
Aqd ke din ulat gayi taqdeer
Teri shaadi hai qoon se tehreer
<<MINI>>
Shaad maani na kuch qushi dekhi
Gham se bharpoor zindagi dekhi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu ne shadi me fatima kubra
Sath jodou ke ek randsaala
Sab se pehle jahez me paya
Kya bayaa'n ho bhala tere gham ka
<<MINI>>
Gham ki tamheed ban gayi shadi
Kya niraali huwi teri shadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye shahe karbala ki shehzaadi
Thi ye shaadi ke teri barbaadi
Gham ka unwaa'n bani teri shadi
Teri qismat hai tujh pe faryaadi
<<MINI>>
Kamsini me naseeb phoot gaya
Tujh pe gham ka pahaad toot gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu ne pehna dulhan ka tha joda
Ya ke pehna tha tu ne randsala
Chand lamho me haye kya ye huwa
Uth gaya sar se saaya waris ka
<<MINI>>
Dulha ran me jo mar gaya tera
Sar se ghungat utar gaya saara
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere qaime me jab ke aag lagi
Jal gaya hujla e uroosi bhi
Kya batau ke kaisi loot machi
Sar se chadar bhi chin gayi teri
<<MINI>>
Dil me armaan ghut gaye saare
Tere zewar bhi lut gaye saare
<<DIVIDER>>
Ran se dulha ki laash jab aayi
Tere chehre pe bewagi chaayi
Tu na fart e hayaa se ro paayi
Tujh ko taqdeer din ye dikhlaayi
<<MINI>>
Nousha e paash paash ke tukde
Tu ne dekhe hai laash ke tukde
<<DIVIDER>>
Fatima kubra aye aseer e mehan
Tujh ko bewa kahu mai ya ke dulhan
Cheen kar tere hathou se kangan
Baandhi thi zalimou ne kas ke rasan
<<MINI>>
Zaqm par zaqm tujhko milte the
Tere pohnche rasan se chilte the
<<DIVIDER>>
Taaziyane wo pusht par khaana
Aisi haalat me dil ko samjhana
Muh ka baalou se parda farmaana
Tera darbaare shaam me jaana
<<MINI>>
Yaad jis waqt humko aata hai
Qoo'n ke aansu hame rulata hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri shadi ka gham hai taaza jo
Hai aqeedat ki intehaa ye to
Aaj tak saatwi moharram ko
Kaale kapde pehan ke sab dekho
<<MINI>>
Sar pe mehndi utha ke laate hai
Teri shadi me rone aate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindagi bhar uthaye tu ne mehan
Apne dulha ko de saki na kafan
Tera ghurbat me ban gaya madfan
Peet kar sar padho ye bait hassan
<<MINI>>
Seh ke sadme guzar gayi haye haye
Fatima kubra mar gayi haye haye
